description: This file defines the LookupRef class with static methods for various spreadsheet lookup and reference functions, many of which are deprecated and delegate to other classes.

classes.name: LookupRef
classes.description: A class providing static methods for various spreadsheet lookup and reference functions, many deprecated.

methods.name: cellAddress
methods.description: Creates a cell address as text, given specified row and column numbers, delegating to Address::cell.

methods.name: COLUMN
methods.description: Returns the column number of a cell reference, delegating to RowColumnInformation::COLUMN.

methods.name: COLUMNS
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in a reference, delegating to RowColumnInformation::COLUMNS.

methods.name: ROW
methods.description: Returns the row number of a cell reference, delegating to RowColumnInformation::ROW.

methods.name: ROWS
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in a reference, delegating to RowColumnInformation::ROWS.

methods.name: HYPERLINK
methods.description: Creates a hyperlink in a cell, delegating to LookupRef\Hyperlink::set.

methods.name: INDIRECT
methods.description: Returns a reference specified by a text string, delegating to Indirect::INDIRECT.

methods.name: OFFSET
methods.description: Returns a reference offset from a cell or range, delegating to Offset::OFFSET.

methods.name: CHOOSE
methods.description: Selects a value from a list based on an index, delegating to LookupRef\Selection::choose.

methods.name: MATCH
methods.description: Searches for a value in a range, delegating to LookupRef\ExcelMatch::MATCH.

methods.name: INDEX
methods.description: Returns a value from a range or array based on row and column indices, delegating to LookupRef\Matrix::index.

methods.name: TRANSPOSE
methods.description: Transposes a matrix, delegating to LookupRef\Matrix::transpose.

methods.name: VLOOKUP
methods.description: Performs a vertical lookup, delegating to VLookup::lookup.

methods.name: HLOOKUP
methods.description: Performs a horizontal lookup, delegating to HLookup::lookup.

methods.name: LOOKUP
methods.description: Performs a general lookup, delegating to Lookup::lookup.

methods.name: FORMULATEXT
methods.description: Returns the formula text of a cell, delegating to LookupRef\Formula::text.
